name: Rancho San Antonio Open Space Preserve
description: Large foothill preserve with trails of many difficulty levels and Deer Hollow Farm, a working farm with animals.
verificationNotes: Parking lots fill up on weekends. Confirm current hours on the Midpeninsula Open Space website before the demo.

name: Cupertino Memorial Park
description: Popular city park with walking paths, an amphitheater, play areas, and sports courts. Hosts community festivals.
verificationNotes: Confirm address on the City of Cupertino parks page (some listings show 21221 Stevens Creek Blvd).

name: McClellan Ranch Preserve
description: Former 1930s horse ranch with a creek, community garden, nature museum, farm animals, and easy walking paths.
verificationNotes: Confirm current hours on the City of Cupertino website.

name: Stevens Creek County Park
description: Foothill county park with multi-use trails, shaded picnic areas, and a reservoir used for fishing and boating.
verificationNotes: County parks charge a vehicle entry fee. Confirm the current fee on the Santa Clara County Parks website.

name: Fremont Older Open Space Preserve
description: 739-acre preserve with rolling hills, open and shaded trails, and wide views over Silicon Valley.
verificationNotes: Street address not verified. Directions use coordinates instead. Main lot is small and fills on weekends.

name: San Jose Municipal Rose Garden
description: 5.5-acre garden from 1927 with thousands of rose bushes, a central fountain, and a large lawn for picnics.
verificationNotes: Roses bloom roughly April through November. Confirm current hours on the San Jose Parks website.

name: Japanese Friendship Garden
description: Japanese-style garden in Kelley Park with a koi pond, arched bridge, tea house, and quiet walking paths.
verificationNotes: Kelley Park parking is paid. Confirm hours and parking fee on the San Jose Parks website.

name: Alum Rock Park
address: 15350 Penitencia Creek Rd, San Jose, CA 95127
description: Large canyon park with hiking and biking trails, historic mineral springs, and picnic areas.
verificationNotes: Confirm current hours and parking fees on the San Jose Parks website.

name: Emma Prusch Farm Park
address: 647 S King Rd, San Jose, CA 95116
description: Community farm park with heirloom gardens, orchards, chickens, and open green lawns.
verificationNotes: Confirm current hours on the San Jose Parks website.
